requirement.description: The base Builder class has incomplete async generator handling in the _send method. It incorrectly handles StopAsyncIteration exceptions and doesn't properly manage the flow of async generators, causing "Task got bad yield" and "coroutine raised StopIteration" errors.

contract.behavior: The _send method must properly handle async generators by: 1. Correctly catching and handling StopAsyncIteration exceptions 2. Properly managing awaitable values yielded from async generators 3. Returning appropriate values for async generator completion 4. Maintaining consistent behavior between sync and async generator handling
contract.inputs: Generator object (sync or async), done list, optional value
contract.outputs: Properly handled result or awaitable for async context
contract.exceptions: StopAsyncIteration should be caught and converted to appropriate return values

requirement.description: The ResultBuilder and AsyncResultBuilder classes have incorrect handling of StopIteration and StopAsyncIteration exceptions in their _send methods. The return values are inconsistent with expected test outcomes.

contract.behavior: The _send method in both ResultBuilder and AsyncResultBuilder must: 1. Correctly extract values from StopIteration and StopAsyncIteration exceptions 2. Return appropriate Ok/Result values based on the yielded values 3. Handle the case where None values should invoke zero() method 4. Ensure that yield from operations correctly propagate values
contract.inputs: Generator object, done list, optional value
contract.exceptions: StopIteration and StopAsyncIteration should be handled consistently

requirement.description: The OptionBuilder and AsyncOptionBuilder classes have incorrect handling of Nothing values in async contexts. The "Cannot await Nothing" error indicates improper handling of awaitable Nothing values.

contract.behavior: The _send method in both OptionBuilder and AsyncOptionBuilder must: 1. Properly detect and handle Nothing values in async contexts 2. Short-circuit properly when Nothing is yielded or returned 3. Return appropriate Some/Option values for normal yields 4. Handle awaitable Nothing values correctly
contract.inputs: Generator object, done list, optional value
contract.exceptions: Nothing values should trigger early termination

requirement.description: The SeqBuilder class has incomplete async generator support and incorrect handling of StopIteration exceptions, causing failures in sequence generation tests.

contract.behavior: The _send method in SeqBuilder must: 1. Properly handle both sync and async generators 2. Correctly convert StopIteration exceptions to appropriate return values 3. Maintain consistency in how values are yielded and collected 4. Support async generators without breaking sync functionality
contract.inputs: Generator object, done list, optional value

requirement.description: The base Builder class has incorrect handling of StopIteration in the main call method, which affects all derived builders. The StopIteration exception handling in the main execution loop is flawed.

contract.behavior: The main __call__ method must: 1. Properly handle StopIteration exceptions that occur during execution 2. Extract values correctly from StopIteration exceptions 3. Ensure that zero() is called appropriately when no value is returned 4. Maintain consistent behavior across sync and async contexts
contract.exceptions: StopIteration should be caught and handled properly to extract return values
